name: add_path
description: Add a JSONPath expression; it gets the next free id (p1, p2, …).

name: reorder_paths
description: Move a path to a position (0 is first).

name: set_expected_count
description: Say how many results a path should give, or -1 for no expectation.

name: set_document
description: Replace the JSON document the paths run against.

name: results
description: What a path selects: its count, its expected count if any, and each result's JSON Pointer and value (at most 200).

name: document_paths
description: The document's nodes as JSON Pointers with their types (at most 200), to learn its shape.
